_llm_instructions: Populate the Quality Management Plan structures.

Quality Standards.guidance:
Array of Quality Standards.
- **Standard / Regulation:** e.g. ISO 9001.
- **Description / Application:** How it applies to the project.

Quality Objectives.guidance:
Array of Quality Objectives.
- **Deliverable / Process:** The item being measured.
- **Quality Metric / Objective:** The specific metric.
- **Target Value:** The target specification or threshold.

Quality Roles and Responsibilities.guidance:
Array of roles.
- **Role:** The job title.
- **Name / Team:** Who fills the role.
- **Quality Responsibilities:** Specific quality-related tasks.

Deliverables and Processes Subject to Qu.guidance:
Array of reviewable items.
- **Deliverable / Process:** The item.
- **Review Type:** Verification or Validation.
- **Reviewer:** Who performs the review.

Quality Management Approach.guidance: Text describing the approach to manage the quality process.

Quality Control Approach.guidance: Text describing the approach to measure performance.

Applicable Quality Procedures.guidance:
Array of procedures (Nonconformance, Corrective actions, Audits, Continuous improvement).
- **Procedure Type:** Name of the procedure.
- **Description / Implementation:** How it is executed.
